body:
Founder real-time: add the arpanet to big_o, clarified via direct question as 'a retro terminal/BBS app on the phone' (genuinely ambiguous otherwise). BP_APP_ARPANET: 5 static text nodes, reusing BP_APP_MESSAGES' list<->detail pattern and BP_APP_NOTES' static-content shape -- deliberately not live chat like BP_APP_GFD. bigo_phone_test.c extended; scripts/build_day.sh/build_client.sh both clean. No real GL driver in this sandbox (standing limitation) -- verified via the standalone logic test. NORTHSTAR.md SS33 added, README corrected. Commit ada2986.

⚓ ☃
title: New ARPANET app -- read-only retro terminal/BBS on the phone
